# Vendor contacts

Last updated in 2024; several people have left their companies. Terms: [terms](../glossary/terms.md); vendors: [subprocessor list](../policies/subprocessor-list.md).

## Payments processor
Escalations for failed payouts go to the processor's partner desk, the named account manager, at the synthetic address payouts-desk@example.invalid.

## Email provider
Delivery problems go to the provider's status contact at the synthetic address mail-desk@example.invalid.
